cost: NFC/token passes O(B) plus search costs; map lookup O(log L) times key lengths; tree O(W log W); frames align O(W*R*lemma_bytes) time and O(W+R+patch_bytes) space; read repeatedly scans children, at most quadratic; realize quote lookup can be quadratic.
description: tokens_up/down retain wrap, NFC deviations by whitespace-run ordinal, noncanonical (sentence,token) gaps and tail. Lookup selects maximum count then smallest form with full/tag/lemma backoff. tree_encode/decode retains form overrides, boundary XORs and written overrides. frames_encode aligns consonant lemmas then two head/relation passes; apply remaps one-based heads and patches zero-based Take coordinates.
forward: tokens_up/down retain wrap, NFC deviations by whitespace-run ordinal, noncanonical (sentence,token) gaps and tail. Lookup selects maximum count then smallest form with full/tag/lemma backoff. tree_encode/decode retains form overrides, boundary XORs and written overrides. frames_encode aligns consonant lemmas then two head/relation passes; apply remaps one-based heads and patches zero-based Take coordinates.
inverse: Without residual, excluded claim: arbitrary original spacing, accents or missing forms are recovered. With generated residual valid domains exclude altered original token/tree bytes.
Token output alone admits all wrap/gap/NFC antecedents; (tokens,R1) reconstructs original text. Generated R3 plus fixed realized words recovers target words, but not unique parsed source forms.
limitations: Finite synthetic helper evidence only; live corpora, parser/model loading, full orchestration and filesystem failure races excluded.
